conversation_intent_review.primary_intent: execute exactly one bounded PTT-02V validator/tooling subphase
conversation_intent_review.allowed_actions: create focused PromptToTask corpus validator, run one focused validator command, write state and gate artifacts
conversation_intent_review.forbidden_actions: PTT-03, OR/SS/AD/API/host work, training, checkpoints, model lifecycle, external AI, browser/image tools, commit, push

architect_critique.item: Future validator modes should eventually live behind a shared plan-gate dispatcher if repeated validator slices accumulate.
architect_critique.reason: A narrowly named validator script is sufficient and safer for this bounded PTT-02V slice.
